about: A change record drafted from the deploy preview (PHASE8_PLAN 16.11 item 3, Decision 5; board CR). Each case is a deploy preview of a real captured configuration (tests/fixtures/configs/fleet/<device>.cfg, the lab's goldens as captured, sanitized) with a minimal edit as committed intent would render it (`edits`); the program, its derived effects against the fleet's intent parsed from the same captures, what verify checks, the stated reasons (`reasons`), the rollback the pipeline would run and Mercury's risk level are computed by the product's own code (`cases.change_record_facts`), and `facts` is what the case expects of that code (`cases.change_record_unready`): a case whose premise the code does not meet fails there, never the model. `expect` is what the drafted words must and must never say (`cases.change_record_misses`, after Mercury's own check, `change_record.check`); `flag` is what only a person can judge in the prose. Written 2026-10-29 from the facts printed by code, before any model run; no answer is recorded yet (the screen, scripts in the scratchpad, runs them on the host through the batch path).

cases.name: shut the P2P link to r4

reasons.shutdown: the link to r4 is being moved to a new circuit tonight

cases.premise: Written expecting risk high (an OSPFv3 adjacency to r4 expected to drop); the code derives no adjacency drop on Gi4 from the fleet's parsed intent (expected_effects.for_device: only 'GigabitEthernet4 goes down'), so Mercury's rule gives medium (1 line needing a stated reason, 1 interface shut). Corrected to the code's answer before any model run.
cases.flag: The risk reads the expected OSPFv3 drop to r4 as the consequence, not a failure, and names what verify checks for it; nothing claims why the link is shut (the stated reason is never sent).

cases.name: an OSPF cost on the core VLAN interface
cases.flag: Says the OSPF setting changes on Gi3 without inventing the value; the risk names routing (path selection) and that verify watches neighbours and routes.

cases.name: a second NTP server (management only)
cases.premise: Written expecting the rollback to hold 'no ntp server 192.0.2.10'; the pipeline's rollback (deploy.rollback_commands) re-sends the existing 'ntp server' line instead, keyed on the command's words without its last token, so the added server would stay after a rollback. Not asserted here: a defect in the rollback, registered, not pinned by a case (the draft draws the rollback exactly as the pipeline would run it).
cases.flag: A management-only change: the risk says only a new login and a read-back are checked, and names no forwarding effect.

cases.name: the logging level raised from critical to warnings
cases.flag: Says the logging (trap) setting changes; does not claim the exact level, which was not sent.

cases.name: a description on an unused switch port (free text never sent)
cases.flag: Says a description is set on Gi0/1 without inventing its text; the risk is a documentation-only change that verify still reads in full.

cases.name: an SNMP location with a community beside it (the secret's line left out)
cases.flag: Says SNMP settings change and, if it mentions the left-out line, only that a line carrying a secret is part of it; never guesses its value.

cases.name: OSPFv3 enabled on the eBGP link to r5
cases.flag: Says OSPFv3 (IPv6 OSPF) settings are added to Gi2; the risk notes an adjacency could form there and that verify reads neighbours and routes; does not name r5 (a device this deploy does not change).

cases.name: a static route to discard a documentation prefix
cases.flag: Says a static route is added without naming its prefix or next hop; the risk names the route table, which verify compares with the moment before.

cases.name: a shorter idle timeout on the first terminal line (management only)
cases.flag: A management-only change to the terminal lines; the risk says a new login is the check and names nothing about forwarding.

cases.name: a new VLAN on the access switch
cases.flag: Says a VLAN is added (or its settings change) without its number or name, which were not sent.
